validation.check: Task database integrity (ratings in {0,0.5,1}; time shares sum to 1)
Use-case mix rows sum to 1
Every sub-sector has tasks and a use-case mix
Accounting identity dLP = (1+dVA)/(1+dL)-1 on all draws
Zero adoption implies zero impact
Monotonicity: higher exposure -> more time saved and higher productivity
Diffusion calibration reproduces CSSF/BCL adoption 2021/22 -> 2024 (30% -> 43%)
validation.note: Exactly identified with two survey waves - calibration, not an out-of-sample test

validation.check: Monte-Carlo convergence: median 2030 employment effect, N/2 vs N draws
Seed stability: median 2030 employment effect under a different seed
Scenario ordering of median 2030 productivity effect (S1 < S2 < S3)
Documented uncertainty: p05 <= p50 <= p95 with non-zero width for every sub-sector, year and metric
Plausibility vs literature: implied annual labour-productivity contribution 2025-2030
validation.note: Bands bracket Acemoglu (2024) economy-wide lower bound and task-level field evidence (14-40% time savings) scaled by exposure and adoption

validation.check: Coverage: every sub-sector has ranges for every scenario, metric and year
Every risk category maps to at least one regulatory reference
All FSB (2024) AI vulnerabilities covered by the taxonomy
Alignment depth: categories referencing the AI Act / DORA
Likelihood and impact weights sum to 1 (scores bounded 1-25)
AI Act classification vignettes (13 archetypes incl. Annex III 5(b)/5(c)/4 and fraud carve-out)
Residual <= inherent and inherent within [1, 25] for all use-case x category cells
Monotonicity (500 random profiles): more controls never raise residual; riskier attributes never lower inherent
Benchmark: employment-weighted share of AI use classified high-risk vs CSSF/BCL self-assessment (5%)
Expert review of taxonomy, weights and control coverage (validation workshop)
validation.value: review form and Fleiss-kappa scorer ready (docs/workshop)
validation.threshold: kappa >= 0.40 and all critical comments resolved
validation.note: Requires the expert-user workshop; results to be entered in docs/workshop/feedback_log.csv

validation.check: Determinism: identical results when re-run with the same seed
Employment covered by integrated sub-sectors (CSSF/CAA-registered entities)
validation.note: LFF 2024 total of 73,272 also includes legal/audit/consulting (~28%), holdings and other financial services
